title.narrative: Strengthening HIV prevention and reduction of Tuberculosis morbidity and mortality - Botswana (01-Jan-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Botswana, TB/HIV, African Comprehensive HIV/AIDS Partnerships (ACHAP)This program has the following goals: To end the Tuberculosis Epidemic. Zero new HIV infections, Zero AIDS related deaths and Zero discrimination by 2030. The objectives of this program are: To reduce mortality of all forms of TB;. To reduce the incidence of all forms of TB. To achieve 90% of all people with HIV knowing their HIV status by 2020 and 95% by 2023. To reduce new infections among young people and adults (15 years old and above) in Botswana to 2,800 by 2020 and less than 2,000 by March 2023. To reduce the number of new infections among children (under 15 years) by 95% 2023. To expand ART coverage to 92% (368,443) of all children, adolescents, young people and adults living with HIV on Treatment by 2020 and 95% (380,458) by 2023 through treat all strategy. To ensure 90% of Adolescents and Youth living with HIV who know their status are put on ART by 2020 and 95% by 2023
